question.zh: 当你说“我没事”的时候，最希望对方怎么做？
question.en: When you say “I’m okay,” what do you most hope the other person will do?

text.zh: 别急着问，先陪我待一会儿
text.en: Stay with me without rushing to ask

echo.zh: 你希望陪伴先于追问
echo.en: You hope presence can come before questions

text.zh: 看出我其实有话没说完
text.en: Notice there is more I have not said

echo.zh: 你希望有人留意那些没有说完的话
echo.en: You hope someone notices what remains unsaid

text.zh: 相信我，让我自己缓一缓
text.en: Believe me and give me a little space

echo.zh: 你希望自己的节奏被尊重
echo.en: You want your own pace to be respected

text.zh: 认真问一句：真的没事吗
text.en: Gently ask if I really am okay

echo.zh: 你期待一次认真而直接的关心
echo.en: You welcome a gentle, direct expression of care

question.zh: 哪一个瞬间，最容易让你觉得“这个人懂我”？
question.en: Which moment most makes you feel understood?

text.zh: 记住我随口提过的小事
text.en: They remember something I mentioned in passing

echo.zh: 小事被记住，会让你感到被放在心上
echo.en: Being remembered in small ways helps you feel cared for

text.zh: 听我说完，而不是立刻给建议
text.en: They listen fully before offering advice

echo.zh: 比起马上得到答案，你更在意先被听完
echo.en: Being fully heard matters more than an immediate solution

text.zh: 我安静时，也不要求我解释
text.en: They let me be quiet without an explanation

echo.zh: 你珍惜不必时刻解释自己的关系
echo.en: You value relationships where silence needs no explanation

text.zh: 温柔地指出我没看见的部分
text.en: They gently name something I had missed

echo.zh: 你愿意在温柔而诚实的回应里看见新角度
echo.en: You welcome a fresh perspective when honesty comes with care

question.zh: 你很想提出一个请求，最后却没有说出口。最可能是因为什么？
question.en: You want to ask for something but hold back. What is most likely behind that pause?

text.zh: 怕给别人添麻烦
text.en: I worry about being a burden

echo.zh: 提出需求之前，你会先顾及对方的负担
echo.en: Before asking, you consider what it might cost the other person

text.zh: 怕被拒绝后，不知道怎么面对
text.en: I am unsure how I would handle a refusal

echo.zh: 你会在提出需求之前，先想一想被拒绝的可能
echo.en: You think about the possibility of refusal before asking

text.zh: 我还没弄清自己真正想要什么
text.en: I am still finding out what I need

echo.zh: 你需要先辨认自己的需求，再把它说清楚
echo.en: You need time to recognize a need before putting it into words

text.zh: 我通常会说，只是会挑时机
text.en: I usually ask, but choose the moment

echo.zh: 你愿意表达需求，也在意开口的时机
echo.en: You are willing to ask, while paying attention to timing

question.zh: 重要的人突然变得冷淡，你最先做的通常是什么？
question.en: Someone important seems distant. What do you usually do first?

text.zh: 回想自己是不是哪里做错了
text.en: Revisit whether I did something wrong

echo.zh: 关系发生变化时，你容易先回看自己做过什么
echo.en: When a relationship shifts, you first revisit your own part

text.zh: 找一个机会，直接问清楚
text.en: Find a moment to ask what is happening

echo.zh: 你更愿意用沟通减少猜测
echo.en: You prefer a conversation to carrying unanswered guesses

text.zh: 给彼此一点时间，再看一看
text.en: Give us both some time and see

echo.zh: 面对暂时的不确定，你会先留出一点时间
echo.en: You make room for time when things feel uncertain

text.zh: 也收回一点自己，避免更难受
text.en: Pull back a little to protect myself

echo.zh: 当靠近让你难受时，你会先保护自己的感受
echo.en: When closeness hurts, you first try to protect your feelings

question.zh: 终于有一个完全属于自己的晚上，你更想怎么过？
question.en: An evening is entirely yours. What would you most like to do?

text.zh: 什么都不安排，安静地待着
text.en: Leave it unplanned and enjoy the quiet

echo.zh: 没有安排的安静，是你愿意留给自己的空间
echo.en: Unplanned quiet is space you want to keep for yourself

text.zh: 做一件没人催、但自己喜欢的事
text.en: Do something I love without being hurried

echo.zh: 你想把时间还给那些出于喜欢的事
echo.en: You want time for things you enjoy for their own sake

text.zh: 和一个不需要费力相处的人说说话
text.en: Talk with someone whose company feels easy

echo.zh: 让你放松的陪伴，是一种恢复精力的方式
echo.en: Easy company can be a way for you to recover energy

text.zh: 把生活整理一下，找回一点秩序
text.en: Put things in order and feel grounded

echo.zh: 一点可掌握的秩序，能让你重新安定下来
echo.en: A little manageable order helps you feel grounded

question.zh: 如果今天只能被认真听见一句话，你想说哪一句？
question.en: If one sentence could truly be heard today, which would it be?

text.zh: “我已经很努力了。”
text.en: “I really have been trying.”

echo.zh: 此刻，你想让自己的努力被看见
echo.en: Right now, you want your effort to be seen

text.zh: “我也需要被照顾。”
text.en: “I need care sometimes, too.”

echo.zh: 此刻，你也想为接受照顾留一个位置
echo.en: Right now, you want to make room to receive care, too

text.zh: “我想按自己的节奏来。”
text.en: “I want to move at my own pace.”

echo.zh: 此刻，你希望自己的节奏得到尊重
echo.en: Right now, you want your pace to be respected

text.zh: “我想让你认识真实的我。”
text.en: “I want you to know the real me.”

echo.zh: 此刻，你期待的是更真实地被认识
echo.en: Right now, you hope to be known more honestly

question.zh: 做一个可能让别人失望的决定时，什么最难放下？
question.en: When a choice might disappoint someone, what is hardest to let go of?

text.zh: 怕关系因此变得不一样
text.en: The possibility that our relationship changes

echo.zh: 你在作选择时，会把关系的变化也放进考虑里
echo.en: When choosing, you also consider what may change between you

text.zh: 觉得自己好像不够好、不够体贴
text.en: The feeling that I am not being considerate enough

echo.zh: 照顾自己的决定，有时也会让你感到为难
echo.en: A choice that cares for you can still feel difficult

text.zh: 不知道自己选得对不对
text.en: Not knowing whether I chose well

echo.zh: 比起别人的反应，你也在寻找对自己选择的把握
echo.en: You are also looking for confidence in your own choice

text.zh: 会难受，但还是想对自己的选择负责
text.en: It hurts, but I want to own my choice

echo.zh: 即使带着不舒服，你仍愿意为自己的选择负责
echo.en: Even with discomfort, you want to take responsibility for your choice

question.zh: 一次争执之后，什么最能让你重新靠近？
question.en: After a disagreement, what helps you feel ready to reconnect?

text.zh: 对方真的听懂了我为什么难受
text.en: They understand why it hurt

echo.zh: 重新靠近之前，你在意自己的感受是否被理解
echo.en: Before reconnecting, you care whether your feelings have been understood

text.zh: 一句道歉之外，还有具体的改变
text.en: There is a concrete change alongside an apology

echo.zh: 比起一句好听的话，你更需要看得见的改变
echo.en: Visible change matters more to you than reassuring words alone

text.zh: 彼此冷静后，再慢慢说清楚
text.en: We have time to settle, then talk it through

echo.zh: 你愿意给修复一点时间，而不急着假装没事
echo.en: You want to give repair time instead of pretending everything is fine

text.zh: 一个真诚的小动作，让我知道关系还在
text.en: A sincere small gesture reminds me the bond is still there

echo.zh: 一个真诚的小动作，可以帮你重新感到连接
echo.en: A sincere small gesture can help you feel connected again

question.zh: 如果暂时不用向任何人证明什么，你最想允许自己怎样？
question.en: If you had nothing to prove for a while, what would you allow yourself?

text.zh: 休息，不再为休息找理由
text.en: Rest without having to justify it

echo.zh: 你想试着让休息不再需要理由
echo.en: You want to let rest exist without a justification

text.zh: 做得不那么完美，也不急着补救
text.en: Leave something imperfect without rushing to fix it

echo.zh: 你想给不完美留一点余地
echo.en: You want to leave a little room for imperfection

text.zh: 试一件喜欢的事，即使没有结果
text.en: Try something I love without needing an outcome

echo.zh: 你想把喜欢放在结果之前一次
echo.en: You want to let enjoyment come before the outcome for once

text.zh: 说一次“不”，不附上很长的解释
text.en: Say no without a long explanation

echo.zh: 你想让一次拒绝不必附带那么多解释
echo.en: You want a no to stand without so much explanation

question.zh: 读完这份报告之后，你最希望带走什么？
question.en: What would you most like to take away from this reflection?

text.zh: 一点“我可以这样”的允许
text.en: A little permission to be as I am

echo.zh: 给自己一点允许
echo.en: Give yourself a little permission

text.zh: 一句把我说不清的感受说清的话
text.en: Words for a feeling I could not explain

echo.zh: 给感受找到自己的名字
echo.en: Find your own words for what you feel

text.zh: 一点去表达真实需求的勇气
text.en: A little courage to express what I need

echo.zh: 让真实的需求有机会被听见
echo.en: Give your real needs a chance to be heard

text.zh: 一个更温柔地看待自己的角度
text.en: A gentler way of looking at myself

echo.zh: 试着用温柔的目光看自己
echo.en: Try looking at yourself with more gentleness
